question.text: The solution of the differential equation <math><mi>x</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>x</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>y</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfrac></math> is <math><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">tan</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>-</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></math> (where, <math><mi>C</mi></math> is an arbitrary constant). If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mn>1,1</mn></mfenced><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn></math>, then <math><mi>f</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>π</mi><mo>,</mo><mi></mi><mi>π</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
Given equation is xdx+ydy=dtan-1⁡yx
On integrating, we get,
x2+y22=tan-1⁡yx+C or tan⁡x2+y22-C=yx
⇒fx,y=x2+y22
∴fπ,π=π2
